newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Kenmare expands operations to Balkans.
newsitem.headline: Kenmare expands operations to Balkans.

text.p: Irish mineral resources company Kenmare Resources Plc said on Wednesday it had increased the area under option in the Niassa province of northern Mozambique and had expanded its operations to the Balkans.
Kenmare said in a statement it had secured title over two additional licences which are contiguous to its southern licence in the Niassa province.
It said these licences cover approximately 100 square kilometres and represent a significant increase of the company's coverage of this gold bearing green-stone belt.
Kenmare also said it had signed an agreement with a geological group called Gemini for the exploration and development of gold properties in former Yugoslavia.
